title: serve a governed geospatial dataset for environmental analysis
input: The geospatial owner prepares imagery assets, metadata and their permitted access scope.
action: Planetary Computer Pro supplies the configured geospatial data-management and access capabilities. Catalog and asset metadata identify the selected data; the analytical runtime performs the environmental computation.
output: The researcher retrieves approved spatial assets and computes the accepted regional indicator.
check: Validate coordinate systems, catalog metadata, asset completeness and dataset licensing before sharing results.

title: run browser acceptance tests against a staging website
input: The release team supplies Playwright tests, approved test accounts and the staging endpoint.
action: The configured Playwright testing service executes supported browser tests using the team's assertions and connectivity settings. Browser sessions exercise the application; assertions determine whether the user journey passed.
output: The pipeline reviews failed steps and accepts only a build meeting the required browser test gates.
check: Test private endpoint reachability, test-account isolation, artifact privacy and cleanup of created test records.

title: discover and govern a sensitive dataset without bypassing source access
input: The data owner registers supported sources and the approved metadata scanning scope.
action: Purview's selected governance capability scans or catalogs supported data assets and their metadata. Classification and lineage inform stewardship; source systems continue enforcing actual data access unless a supported policy integration is configured.
output: The steward assigns ownership and validates an access request through the actual source authorization process.
check: Check scan coverage, metadata privacy, classification quality and denied-source access before accepting governance coverage.

title: assist an analyst investigating a validated security incident
input: The analyst selects an incident and permitted connected security evidence.
action: Security Copilot assists supported investigation tasks using configured plugins and the analyst's authorized context. Generated summaries and hypotheses need evidence validation; tool access determines which actions can be invoked.
output: The responder checks the cited evidence and performs only an independently approved containment action.
check: Test evidence accuracy, plugin scope, cross-tenant denial and the actual result of containment before closure.

title: deliver an application notification to registered devices
input: The application selects consented user registrations and the approved notification payload.
action: Notification Hubs routes supported push messages to configured platform notification services using registration or tag targeting. Platform acceptance and actual device delivery are separate outcomes; the application controls recipient selection.
output: The device receives the push when its platform permits delivery and retrieves protected details from the authenticated API.
check: Test tag isolation, expired registrations, provider errors and absence of sensitive content in the push payload.

title: move a supported Nutanix workload to Azure-connected capacity
input: The virtualization owner inventories VMs, storage dependencies and supported Nutanix cluster requirements.
action: The configured Nutanix Cloud Clusters offering supplies the selected Nutanix infrastructure on Azure. Supported migration tools move VM state; network and software compatibility require explicit validation.
output: The application runs on the target cluster and reaches its approved corporate and cloud dependencies.
check: Check current provider support, final synchronization, VM compatibility and rollback before moving client traffic.

title: inspect an agent's failed tool invocation using recorded traces
input: The operator selects the deployed agent, failed request identifier and permitted telemetry scope.
action: The configured Foundry observability capabilities expose supported traces, metrics or evaluation evidence. Instrumentation captures the run and tool calls; observing a trace does not execute the agent's business action again.
output: The engineer identifies the failing tool or model step and proposes a scoped application repair.
check: Reproduce the failure safely and verify trace completeness, sensitive-field handling and repaired request behavior.

title: host a selected small model for a bounded classification task
input: The ML owner selects permitted model weights, serving runtime and representative classification inputs.
action: The chosen Phi model runs in the configured inference host and generates supported responses from the input. Model licensing, memory requirements and serving implementation determine the deployment; weights are not a standalone managed API.
output: The classifier validates returned labels and routes unsupported output to its review path.
check: Evaluate accuracy, runtime compatibility, resource use and prompt-injection behavior before release.

title: publish an authorized executive reporting model
input: The analyst defines permitted source data, semantic measures and dashboard audiences.
action: Power BI's configured data and semantic model supports refresh, calculations and interactive reports. Workspace permissions and row-level rules determine viewer access; source ingestion and report calculations require validation.
output: The executive opens the published report and views only the accepted business measures and allowed records.
check: Reconcile totals, refresh freshness and audience restrictions against known source transactions.

title: embed a tenant-scoped report in a business portal
input: The portal validates the customer and selects the permitted report and dataset scope.
action: Power BI Embedded supports application-hosted report rendering under the selected capacity and embedding authentication model. The backend issues scoped embed authorization; the portal enforces customer ownership and dataset restrictions.
output: The customer views the embedded report for its permitted tenant and report parameters.
check: Test embed-token scope, row-level security, expiry and cross-tenant denial before exposing the report.
